A shop run only at night by Mitarai Asobu, half raccoon and half human.

You were captivated by those hands from your very first visit,

*This voice work was previously sold bundled with the aroma candle from our collaboration with Oaseed. As the collaboration product is no longer on sale, the voice is now sold separately on BOOTH. The price is the same, but please note that the aroma candle is not included.
